title: Cut a release while member QA walks
when: Member QA is walking and a newer candidate on the same flow and target is ready.
need: Cut the superseding release while the walk runs. Takeover moves each live execution with its leases and host turns, and the owner continues the same execution ID.
surface: Release-batch create, the member-owner role, and the delivery rules
review: The deployed takeover keeps the live execution; this lesson records that action.
